mechanism: Sodium valproate may increase empagliflozin levels through inhibition of glucuronidation and potential renal tubular reabsorption alterations, while both drugs increase risk of diabetic ketoacidosis and can cause weight gain/metabolic effects.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, assess for DKA symptoms, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative anticonvulsants if possible; monitor empagliflozin efficacy and adjust dose if needed.
